args.message: Use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) in round_money per FIN-212

args.head: fix/money-half-even-rounding
args.title: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212
args.body:
The nightly build was failing because `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP` (despite its docstring stating HALF_EVEN).

Change: switch `round_money` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN`.

CI: run ci-0001 on 08d3cd5986 passed.

Note: the advisory lookup tool didn't recognize FIN-212, so the requirement is taken from the test and the docstring.

trace.final:
I fixed the rounding bug, CI passed, and the pull request is open with alex as reviewer.

- **Cause:** In `src/money.py`, `round_money` rounded halves up (`ROUND_HALF_UP`), even though its docstring says it uses banker's rounding. So `2.665` came out as `2.67`, but the test expects `2.66`.
- **Fix:** On a new branch, `fix/money-half-even-rounding`, I changed it to use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`).
- **CI:** Run ci-0001 passed.
- **PR:** [#101](https://git.example/payments-service/pull/101) against main. I haven't merged it, since merging into main needs a code owner's approval.

I couldn't look up FIN-212 because the advisory tool doesn't recognise that ID. The fix follows what the test and the docstring both say, and the PR description notes this.
